{{Quote|These ''jet-wings'' are for ''spraying fertilizers'', Master&mdash;not attacking ''droid ships''!|Ahsoka Tano, to Anakin Skywalker|<ref name="IJ" />}}
'''Jet-wings''' were a model of [[Color/Legends|silver]] and blue flying vehicle used on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Gall/Legends|Gall]] to spray [[Fertilizer/Legends|fertilizers]] on [[Plant/Legends|crops]]. They consisted of a long sleek body, which housed the single [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] in an open-air [[Cockpit/Legends|cockpit]], and a pair of wings located above the body at the back of the vehicle. The wings were attached to the circular rear of the vehicle by six struts.<ref name="IJ" />

Between [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] and [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]],<ref name="Date">"[[Inside Job]]" takes place during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], which started in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] according to ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'', and depicts [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] as a [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], which she left during the events of "[[The Wrong Jedi]]," which took place in [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]] per {{FactFile2014|42|20 BBY 51-54|Jedi Temple bombing}}.</ref> during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and<ref name="IJ" /> his<ref name="TPM">{{Film|I}}</ref> [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], used jet-wings during a [[Battle of Gall (Clone Wars)|battle]] on Gall, while their own vehicles were [[Fuel/Legends|refueling]]. Despite Tano's doubts about the vehicles' suitability for combat, the pair used the jet-wings to avoid the [[Sensor/Legends|sensors]] of the [[Shielded Separatist craft|Separatist craft]] leading and [[Unidentified deflector shield model|shielding]] the other Separatist vessels. They breached the [[Starship/Legends|ship's]] [[Deflector shield/Legends|shields]], landing the jet-wings on its surface and dismounting, after which the vehicles were destroyed.<ref name="IJ" />

==Behind the scenes==
Jet-wings appeared in "[[Inside Job]]," a [[Star Wars comic books|comic story]] written by [[Rik Hoskin]] and illustrated by [[Andres Ponce]] that was published by [[Titan Magazines]] in the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Comic 6.1|first issue of the sixth volume]] of the [[Star Wars Comic|'' Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' Comic]] magazine series<ref name="IJ" /> on [[November 12]], [[2009]].<ref name="ReleaseDate">{{WebCite|url=https://www.theforce.net/latestnews/story/New_UK_The_Clone_Wars_Comic_Announced_127300.asp|text=New UK The Clone Wars Comic Announced|author=Barrick, Mike|date=2009-04-11|work=[[TheForce.net]]|archivedate=20200812092247}}</ref>
